criteria.name: r1_checks_a_drawn_allowance_on_its_own_extract
criteria.description: The agent constructs its own extract in which a site's allowance covers its offer in a later event only if no offer of that site was chosen in an earlier event, while an offer of that site is chosen in the earlier event, runs derive_report.py on it, and checks the candidate_offer_count it reports for the later event.
criteria.reasoning: The synthetic extract does not exercise the required case. Its earlier event selects SA3 rather than the shared SA1 offer, and it does not explicitly verify that a later event's candidate count falls because the same allowance was consumed by an earlier selected offer.

criteria.name: r2_checks_start_order_on_its_own_extract
criteria.description: The agent constructs its own extract in which two events share a site whose allowance covers only one of their offers, and the event that starts first has the greater event_id and the later sorting dispatch_start text (for example because the two start times carry different UTC offsets), runs derive_report.py on it, and checks which of the two events selects that site's offer.
criteria.reasoning: The synthetic EV-A and EV-B timestamps do represent the same instant with differently sorting timestamp text and EV-B has the greater ID, but SA1's 1000-tick allowance covers both 100-tick offers. Thus it does not test an allowance covering only one offer or verify which event wins that constrained allowance.

criteria.name: r3_checks_a_composed_rate_above_cap_on_its_own_extract
criteria.description: The agent constructs its own extract in which a chosen offer's rate card carries an override element, its event has a non-zero uplift and its segment a non-zero rate adder, with the resulting rate above the card's cap, runs derive_report.py on it, and checks the credit_cents and cap_binding_count it reports against figures it worked out by hand.
criteria.reasoning: No chosen synthetic offer combines all required elements. EV-A/SA3 has an override, public-segment adder, and binding cap but zero event uplift; EV-B/SB1 has uplift and an adder but no override. The shipped-data Decimal check is not the required self-constructed extract.

criteria.name: r4_checks_a_half_cent_interval_amount_on_its_own_extract
criteria.description: The agent constructs its own extract in which one interval amount of a chosen offer's credit is exactly half a cent, works out that offer's credit_cents by hand, runs derive_report.py on the extract, and compares the two.
criteria.reasoning: The synthetic extract's chosen OFF-C1 has 50 credited ticks × 10 Wh × 3000 mill-cents/kWh / 1,000,000 = exactly 1.5 cents. The hard-coded expected EV-B/Red credit is 2 cents under half-to-even rounding, and the script runs derive_report.py and compares that expectation successfully.

criteria.name: r5_exact_arithmetic_for_reported_figures
criteria.description: The agent's final derive_report.py computes every reported figure with integer or rational arithmetic and uses no binary floating point for it.
criteria.reasoning: Reported energy, money, ratios, objective components, grant shares, and rounding are calculated with Python integers and divmod-based rounding. No binary floating-point arithmetic is used for reported figures.

criteria.name: r6_final_run_after_last_edit
criteria.description: The agent runs its final derive_report.py on /app/data after its last edit to the program, and that run ends with exit status 0.
criteria.reasoning: After the final program edit in step 35, the agent ran the program successfully in step 36 and then, in step 39, deleted the shipped JSON outputs and regenerated them with `python3 out/derive_report.py data out`; that command completed successfully.

criteria.name: r7_claims_a_check_its_output_contradicts
criteria.description: The response says a check of derive_report.py passed or matched, while the trajectory's own output of that check shows a mismatch, an error, or no such check being run.
criteria.reasoning: The final response claims that every export_manifest.tsv field_sum was reproduced exactly, but the trajectory contains no actual manifest-versus-parser comparison producing that result. Step 12 prints independently calculated sums, but no manifest values or equality checks are shown.

criteria.name: r8_recomputes_grant_cents_outside_the_program
criteria.description: The agent independently recomputes every beneficiary's grant cents for at least three event-regions outside derive_report.py, from the funded pool and the program.ini grants keys, and compares them with the grants its region documents report.
criteria.reasoning: The synthetic test independently hard-codes and checks funded amounts and every listed beneficiary grant for at least EV-A/Red, EV-B/Red, and EV-C/Red, using the configured 40 cents-per-weight rule. It loads and compares the generated region documents. Step 28 additionally independently checks raw recipient weights and claims across the shipped claims-paid event-regions.

criteria.name: r9_recomputes_remaining_allowance_outside_the_program
criteria.description: The agent independently recomputes, outside derive_report.py, the remaining allowance that each chosen offer's site drew on when its event was reached, following draws_from in site_allowances.tsv, and compares it with the offers its region documents select.
criteria.reasoning: The independent replay checks aggregate candidate, blocked, and ineligible counts and uses selected offers to advance allowance usage, but it does not explicitly recompute and compare the remaining allowance for every chosen offer's site against the selections in the written region documents.

criteria.name: r10_recomputes_credit_cents_outside_the_program
criteria.description: The agent independently recomputes the credit_cents of the chosen offers outside derive_report.py, from their credited relief ticks and effective rates, and compares them with the credit_cents its region documents report.
criteria.reasoning: Step 27 independently recomputes every chosen offer's credit with Decimal, but compares each result to another in-memory calculation using derive_report's parsed objects and only compares the grand total to summary.json. It does not aggregate and compare every event-region's independently calculated chosen-offer credits with all written region-document credit_cents values.

criteria.name: r11_derive_report_is_maintainable
criteria.description: The agent leaves a /app/out/derive_report.py that a Python reviewer would accept as maintainable, judged on its names, function structure and error handling.
criteria.reasoning: The final program is large but reasonably structured: parsing is organized into named Extract loader methods, rounding and grant logic are separate functions, optimisation and report generation are distinct, names are descriptive, and comments document the non-obvious pruning invariant. Errors generally fail fast through standard exceptions rather than being silently masked.
